statement: ∀ (K F : Type) [NontriviallyNormedField K] [NontriviallyNormedField F] [CompleteSpace K] [CompleteSpace F] (e : K ≃+* F), Continuous e → Continuous e.symm → ∀ q u : K, e (∑' n : ℤ, q^(n*(n+1)/2)*u^(2*n+1)) = ∑' n : ℤ, (e q)^(n*(n+1)/2)*(e u)^(2*n+1)

plain_statement.zh: 新路线 · 指定 Kummer 像与 Θ 测试 · JA-0040 · 沿双连续标记同构运输 Theta 级数
plain_statement.en: New route · Marked Kummer images and theta tests · JA-0040 · Transport the theta series along a bicontinuous marking

brief.zh: 先沿同一个保双向连续标记运输整个双边级数，再以域同构的乘除相容运输比值。
brief.en: Transport the bilateral series along one bicontinuous marking, then use compatibility with field division to transport the quotient.
